levels.surface: إسحاق، بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة
إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة

notes: «وحدثنيه» after the first saying opens a second isnad, its own group; its matn is said to be «بمثله» with a variant, so the second group repeats its own names and the tail is null; the stray comma inside «إسحاق، بن عبد الله» is kept as written; the Prophet is not a link
